sourceVerification.scope: Saved CPU reference matrices only; no new forward, no training or threshold changes.

sources.execution: CPU BF16 reference forward, FP32 routing, exact CPU average linkage; not bitwise GPU parity
sources.selection: First examples in the existing fixed held-out COCO evaluation order, before inspecting groups
sources.scope: Teacher-noised held-out images and original captions, not generated samples
sources.hardScope: Original token-position membership. Features already interact through joint attention.
sources.softScope: Stage 1: column-normalized reader P1. Stage 2: P1 @ P2, a routing-only composition, not causal attribution.
sources.noiseScope: Fixed CPU Gaussian noise, sigma=2, same noise per example across levels; not the CUDA sampler noise stream

connectionScope.group: Original-position soft pooling into the selected group: P1 or P1 @ P2.
connectionScope.patch: Routing-only connection from an image patch through readback and pooling: A1 @ P1.T, or (A1 @ A2) @ (P1 @ P2).T.
connectionScope.group_readback: Uniform average of the patch connection vectors over the selected hard group’s original image patches.
connectionScope.not_attention: These are routing connections, not Transformer attention, causal attribution, or an exact decomposition of the model output. Compact blocks and skips also mix information.
connectionScope.encoding: Packed arrays use lossless zlib + base64 little-endian float32; image heatmaps use uint8 relative to each group’s largest image weight.

sourceVerification.scope: Actual full production Hopper GPU forward with exact GPU linkage, compiled BF16 backbone and FP32 readers. No training or threshold changes.

sources.execution: Actual full production Hopper GPU forward with exact GPU linkage, compiled BF16 backbone and FP32 readers.
sources.selection: Two user uploads, followed by the first 18 images in the fixed held-out COCO order; selected before routing.
sources.scope: Teacher-noised input images with supplied captions; not generated samples or semantic segmentation.
sources.hardScope: Original-position hard membership. Stage 2 is hard membership lineage through stage 1; features also undergo global soft pooling.
sources.softScope: Stage 1 P1; stage 2 P1 @ P2. Routing connections, not attention or causal attribution.
sources.noiseScope: Fixed CPU Gaussian draw per image, sigma=2, unchanged across checkpoints and t. Input is t*image+(1-t)*noise; display clipping only.

connectionScope.group: Original-position soft pooling into the selected group: P1 or P1 @ P2.
connectionScope.patch: Routing-only connection from an image patch through readback and pooling: A1 @ P1.T, or (A1 @ A2) @ (P1 @ P2).T.
connectionScope.group_readback: Uniform average of the patch connection vectors over the selected hard group’s original image patches.
connectionScope.not_attention: These are routing connections, not Transformer attention, causal attribution, or an exact decomposition of the model output. Compact blocks and skips also mix information.
connectionScope.encoding: Packed arrays use lossless zlib + base64 little-endian float32; image heatmaps use uint8 relative to each group’s largest image weight.

forwardSelection: One active token selects its original hard group and original uint8 heatmap. Token maps are not combined.
reverseSelection: One image patch selects its original float32 connection to every active token. End and standalone word-start tokens stay visible. No token weights are combined.
normalization: Forward heatmaps retain the source per-group maximum normalization. Reverse color uses the maximum over every active token at both levels for the selected patch and time. End is included. Percentages use total routing weight.
sourceLimit: Verified JSON exports are available. Original NPZ files are absent. No missing forward matrices were reconstructed.
